Iluka's stated envelope covers 'mineral sands concentrates, hard rock concentrates and ionic clay carbonates'. SARECO's product is a carbonate derived from HARD ROCK monazite, which falls between the named classes rather than squarely inside one, so PLAUSIBLE rather than FEED_ENVELOPE. Commercially awkward too: Lindian already supplies Eneabba with concentrate directly, and routing the same material through SARECO first would compete with that contract. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC.

NON-BINDING MOU of 2 May 2024, still non-binding as at Meteoric's 1 Sep 2026 half-year report. 3,000 t TREO/yr of MREC to NPM Silmet in Estonia, running until Neo has purchased 30,000 t TREO cumulative, with a right of first refusal on additional material once Caldeira exceeds 6,000 t TREO/yr. PER-ELEMENT SPLIT IS DISCLOSED: 'as much as 900 MT of Nd-Pr oxide and 30 MT of Dy-Tb oxide, combined' - one of the few offtakes in this graph with a stated Dy/Tb figure. QUALIFIED tier because Neo names this specific deposit as the intended feed for a named facility; status POTENTIAL because the agreement is not binding. This is the missing link that connects Caldeira to the Caremag-to-Narva European magnet chain. OVERLAP RISK: Neo's right of first refusal covers 'additional material when the Caldeira Project produces more than 6,000 MT TREO per year' - potentially everything above 6,000 t/yr. Exercised in full it directly conflicts with both POSCO's 30% and Ucore's 3,000 t. The three MOUs are not mutually reconciled. Note also that Neo's FY2025 Annual Information Form DROPPED the Caldeira MOU, which the FY2024 AIF had carried twice - a possible cooling signal.

NON-BINDING Memorandum of Strategic Partnership signed 28 Jul 2026: 'approximately 30% of rare earth material sourced from Caldeira for a period of up to seven years', priced off an independent mechanism initially referenced to the Asian Metal Index. NO TONNAGE and NO per-element Dy/Tb split is disclosed by either party - unusually, POSCO's own release says less than Meteoric's. Counterparty is the organization, not a facility: POSCO International would produce REO for Korean magnet makers, but no receiving plant is named. annual_tonnes left null deliberately - 30% of 12,500 t would be ~3,750 t but that is inference, not disclosure. TIER UPGRADED TO QUALIFIED on a testwork statement in the same release: 'Metallurgical testwork confirms Caldeira's low impurity MREC is able to be processed by POSCO without additional refining steps.' That is testwork on this specific feed, which is the QUALIFIED bar - the non-binding commercial status is captured separately by status POTENTIAL. Note also POSCO discloses LESS than Meteoric: the 30% and seven-year figures appear only in Meteoric's ASX release, and POSCO's own newsroom gives no tonnage, percentage or term.

Share Purchase and Investment Agreement signed 22 Jul 2026, NOT CLOSED as at 31 Aug 2026. USAR takes 177,778 Preferred Shares RR for approximately 13.6% of Carester (up from 12.5% in the April term sheet), via EUR 10.8m cash, EUR 11.7m contributed in USAR common stock, EUR 5.0m of secondary shares from the founder, and EUR 12.5m buying out Rhodia Operations. STRATEGICALLY THE MOST INTERESTING DETAIL: the Rhodia purchase results in 'the full exit of Solvay as a shareholder of Carester' - so Europe's incumbent separator is leaving the shareholder register of Europe's new one, replaced by a US company and a French infrastructure fund. Completion expected Q3 2026.

USAR's April 2026 investor deck describes a '15-year supply: excess concentrate from Round Top or other USAR sources to Caremag', with a reciprocal 15-year offtake under which USAR takes oxides produced from its contributed concentrate. PLAUSIBLE not FEED_ENVELOPE despite the named source, because Round Top does not yet produce anything: it is an S-K 1300 exploration-stage property with no declared resources, a PFS still unfinished, and commercial operation expected 'late 2028'. The word 'excess' also implies Round Top's own captive separation has first call. Long-dated option, not a contingency route. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC dominated by mine construction, not qualification.

CONDITIONAL OFFTAKE OPTION, not an offtake: granted April 2026 as consideration for a tenement transfer, alongside a Meteoric board nomination right. 'The Offtake Option allows Togni to acquire up to 30% of the annual production from the Caldeira Project by providing five (5) years advance notice ... on a take or pay basis and provides that use of the MREC may not compete with Meteoric's interests.' No qualification tier: this is a commercial call on volume, not a technical routing claim, and the destination facility is unknown. It is the claim that tips Caldeira's total potential commitments past its production - see the project description.

DOWNGRADED FROM QUALIFIED. I previously recorded this as the graph's only compatibility edge resting on actual testwork of a named deposit. A counterparty sweep of both companies' continuous-disclosure filings does not support that, and partly contradicts it. The QUALIFIED claim rests entirely on the headline and body of one Ucore NEWS RELEASE of 29 Apr 2024 ('Ucore Qualifies Wicheeda Mixed Rare Earth Carbonate...'). Against it: (1) Ucore's own MD&A series says only that Defense Metals 'sent' a sample - unchanged boilerplate for over two years, with no date, mass, grade, impurity data or ANY RESULT; (2) Ucore's Q1 2026 MD&A states that all seven DoD demonstration campaigns ran on a SINGLE heavy MREO feed source, and Wicheeda is not identified among them; (3) Defense Metals' own filings NEVER mention a sample to Ucore - their only shipment disclosure is an Oct 2023 distribution to unnamed recipients that predates the Jan 2024 MOU, with results still 'ongoing' 21 months later. A news-release headline uncorroborated by either party's filings, and in tension with one of them, does not meet the QUALIFIED bar of demonstrated testwork. FEED_ENVELOPE is the honest tier: Wicheeda MREC is squarely within Ucore's stated MREC/MREO class. Re-check when Defense Metals' post-Apr-2025 filings or its SEDAR+ PFS technical report become reachable.

BINDING TAKE-OR-PAY, LIVE SINCE 21-24 AUG 2026, covering 100% of Phase 1 Nd, Pr, Dy and Tb. THE LOCK IS NARROWER THAN IT LOOKS: yttrium is expressly carved out and is 42% of life-of-mine basket value, and a potential Phase 2 of roughly +6,400 tpa TREO is not covered. Floor prices Tb US$2,050/kg, Dy US$575/kg, Nd and Pr US$110/kg, escalating 2% annually with 70% of any excess over the market index returning to the seller - struck BELOW then-prevailing ex-China spot, so downside insurance rather than subsidy. Term is legally the earlier of 198 Mt of run-of-mine ore or 20 years from a Commercial Operations Date that has not yet occurred; the '15-year' framing in all marketing is unreconciled shorthand. US SIIE also holds a call option over ALL SVRE equity. The buyer resells to separators, so the material is redirected through a US-government-controlled chokepoint rather than withdrawn.

PLACEHOLDER EDGE for the Malaysian ionic-clay feed route, drawn from org-lynas to its own plant because the counterparty - Menteri Besar Inc, the strategic investment arm of the Kelantan State Government - has no project or deposit node and no disclosed resource. Non-binding MoU of 30 May 2025 for supply of Malaysian ionic-clay MREC to Kuantan, with Lynas reserving a quality gate. STALE: MB Inc has vanished from Lynas disclosure since, never reaching definitive agreement. This is the only named third-party feed Lynas Malaysia has ever disclosed, and the FY2026 Annual Report now states the HRE expansion REQUIRES feedstock beyond Mt Weld to hit nameplate - so the gap between the 300 tpa Dy+Tb nameplate and the roughly 60-100 tpa Mt Weld can support is currently unbridged by any named source. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC.

FEED_ENVELOPE tier, but assertion_confidence LOW because the only record is a machine-generated third-party transcript - MP publishes none - and the statement has not been repeated in any filing. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC. The strongest chemical fit into this node, though the material is contracted to Caremag for up to 150 tpa contained DyTb.

Material WAS physically sent - a 10 gram sample of Deep Leads maiden MREC, one of six recipients, dispatched by 2 Mar 2026 - and ABx reports 'highly favourable feedback' from Ucore. FEED_ENVELOPE not QUALIFIED for three reasons: ten grams is an evaluation sample, not a processing campaign; ABx never states which Ucore facility received it; and no recovery, purity or separated product is disclosed by either party. Contrast ABx's disclosure for a different customer, where it did report a finding - 'RETi advised that the Deep Leads MREC is of high purity and is suitable for the RETi process'. Under the Sep 2024 MOU Ucore has an intended first right of refusal over 50% of ABx annual volume for at least five years.

NO SEPARATION COUNTERPARTY IS PUBLICLY ESTABLISHED. The 20 Aug 2026 funding release lists 'finalising binding offtake' among the immediate priorities alongside the senior debt package and EPCM mobilisation, and names no offtaker anywhere. Viridis and its Brazilian investors state an intent to 'maximise rare earth industrialisation capability in Brazil, including downstream processing', which points at a domestic separation route that does not exist yet in this graph - there is no Brazilian separation facility node. Until an offtake is signed, roughly 124 tpa of contained Dy+Tb has no committed ex-China separation home. Resolve this edge when binding offtake is announced.

Iluka states Eneabba is 'capable of processing a broad range of feedstocks including mineral sands concentrates, hard rock concentrates and ionic clay carbonates' (Investor Briefing, 5 May 2025). Colossus ships ionic clay MREC, squarely inside that stated class, so the tier matches the other Brazilian ionic clay nodes. FEED_ENVELOPE not QUALIFIED: the class is stated, this source is not. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

Energy Fuels is adding an MREC circuit at White Mesa specifically to take heavy-rich third-party feedstocks. Colossus MREC is inside that class on form. Note the mismatch in kind rather than form: White Mesa's expansion is sized for Dy and Tb, and Colossus is a lanthanum-dominated basket carrying only about 124 tpa Dy+Tb, so it would be a low-tenor feed for that circuit. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

Ucore's declared feed envelope is MREC/MREO, which Colossus MREC sits inside on form. Ucore's published capacities are contained TREO in feedstock and are feed-agnostic, so no Dy/Tb throughput can be inferred for this route. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

Pulawy is designed around MREC feed, so Colossus material is inside the stated class. The facility's own 50 tpa Dy/Tb figure is flagged CONFLICTED, so do not size this route from it. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

Silmet accepts MREC. Neo discloses no tonnage for its HREE line and describes the products as 'pre-cursor dysprosium and terbium' process solutions rather than finished oxide, so this route cannot be sized either. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

MP's COO named two accepted feed classes, SEG+ and a full MREC containing both lights and heavies. Colossus MREC is the latter on form, and its very high La and low Ce would land in MP's lights circuits rather than the Dy/Tb circuit. LOW confidence: the envelope comes from an earnings call, not a specification. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.

PLAUSIBLE, NOT FEED_ENVELOPE - and deliberately rated below the equivalent Serra Verde edge. Carester's stated feed classes are end-of-life magnets and 'mining concentrates'; a mixed rare earth carbonate is not a mining concentrate, so MREC sits outside Carester's stated class on form. This is the same reasoning the Lofdal and Caldeira edges already apply. The existing Serra Verde and Lofdal MREC-into-Caremag edges are rated FEED_ENVELOPE and PLAUSIBLE respectively for materially the same product form; that inconsistency predates this node and is flagged rather than silently propagated. qualification_lead_months is a MODELLING HEURISTIC for disruption scenarios, not a disclosed lead time.
